visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a hand folding a golden-brown pancake in a non-stick pan. Then it cuts to hands using a chef's knife to slice the folded pancake into triangles on a black cutting board. (2) A hand cracks a whole egg into a Pyrex glass measuring cup. (3) The hand uses a wire whisk to beat the egg, then pours white liquid from a carton into the cup and continues whisking. (4) White powder is poured from a bag into the mixture, and the hand whisks it vigorously; the batter appears slightly lumpy at first. (5) A digital timer is shown on a white background, being set for 10 minutes by a finger pressing buttons. (6) After the time, the whisking continues until the batter looks smooth and fine. (7) The batter is poured into a shallow pan on an induction cooktop, and a glass lid with a red knob is placed over it. (8) Bubbles appear on the surface of the pale batter as it cooks under the lid. (9) A black spatula is used to test the elasticity of the surface and gently lift the edges of the now set, porous pancake. (10) Hands carefully peel the edges of the pancake away from the pan using the spatula and fingers. (11) Chocolate and peanut spreads are applied to the surface of the pancake with a spoon. Dark poppy seeds or black sesame seeds are sprinkled over the fillings. (12) The pancake is folded in half and then into a roll, removed from the pan, and sliced again on the board, showing a cross-section of the porous texture and creamy filling.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with an upbeat acoustic pop song featuring a bright guitar melody and a male vocal singing in Mandarin. A sharp percussive 'thud' SFX accompanies the visual of the spatula hitting the board. (2) A crisp 'crack' sound of an eggshell is synchronized with the egg being opened at the 0:04 mark. (3) Rapid rhythmic 'whisking' sounds follow, overlapping with the BGM. (4) A metallic 'clink' and 'ticking' sound are heard when the digital timer is set at 0:15. (5) A muffled 'thump' of a lid closing on a pan occurs at 0:18, followed by a faint sizzling sound buried in the mix. (6) Multiple rhythmic 'scraping' and 'slicing' sound effects occur between 0:25 and 0:50, perfectly synced with the spatula and knife movements on the cutting board. The music remains continuous throughout, providing a high-energy backdrop.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Ingredient Prep -> Cooking Process -> Assembly -> Finished Product Showcase.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a clear, step-by-step tutorial on how to make a perfect 'Mai Zi Jian' pancake. It uses a upbeat tempo and satisfying sound effects to make the process look easy and appetizing, encouraging viewers to try the recipe at home.
